title: A low-cost alternative method of generating fibronectin micropatterned lines for cellular applications
author: Becher, Lautenschläger, et al.

steps.title: Prepare macrophage suspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend macrophages to a concentration of 4000 cells per µl.

steps.title: Seed cells onto patterned dish
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl of the macrophage suspension (4000 cells/µl) onto the glass‑bottom dish containing 5 µm‑wide fibronectin‑coated lines and incubate for 1 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Wash dish with PBS
steps.instruction: Gently wash the dish once with phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS) to remove unattached cells.

steps.title: Fix cells with paraformaldehyde
steps.instruction: Fix the cells by adding 4 % paraformaldehyde (Science Service) and incubate for 10 min.

steps.title: Mount sample with DAPI
steps.instruction: Mount the fixed sample using Fluoromount‑G™ Mounting Medium containing DAPI (Invitrogen).

steps.title: Acquire fluorescence images
steps.instruction: Capture images of DAPI‑stained nuclei on the fibronectin‑coated lines using a Nikon Ti‑Eclipse fluorescence microscope.
